requirements.requirement: Demonstrate (show) that end-to-end connectivity continues across one such transit-network-down transition
requirements.summary: The instruction explicitly requires showing continuity across a bounded disruption (taking one transit network out of service, observing continued reachability, and recovery). Interface down/up cycling was performed early in the session (e.g., cmd-63b3f0b9118440e4, cmd-39162bbafcc14bd1, cmd-dd39fa6f1a2740a5), but these predate the final redundant-path solution (different addressing, before routes/gateway-group/no-NAT were configured) and only tested raw interface reachability, not the finished failover path. After the final configuration was validated bidirectionally (~05:02:39), the managed cluster lease expired only ~2 seconds later (cmd-b60712d6e43d4e83, 'cluster_expired') before any transit-down/up transition could be attempted against the completed solution.
